consentText: This app is also a research instrument. If you agree, your questionnaire answers, task responses and the demographic details you provide are stored on a research server under a participant ID, not your name, and may be analysed and published in aggregate. You can stop at any time. Contact details and the full consent form are in the study information below.
studyInfo: Study title: Mental imagery across the senses. Principal investigator: [name], Imagination and Modal Cognition Lab, Duke University. IRB protocol: [number]. Contact: [email]. Data are retained for [N] years and may be shared in de-identified form. To withdraw, email your participant ID to the contact above and all server data will be deleted.

vviq.label: Vividness (VVIQ-style)
vviq.desc: 16 scenes, 4 min. Places you on the spectrum.

multi.label: Multisensory imagery
multi.desc: Sight, sound, smell, taste, touch, body, feeling.

memory.label: Memory & counterfactual
memory.desc: Recall an event, then imagine it differently.

col.label: Imagery color match
col.desc: Imagine a blend, pick the swatch.

interference.label: Imagery & perception
interference.desc: Does imagining a color change what you can see? 24 quick trials.

scene.label: Scene memory, two sessions
scene.desc: Learn a scene today, get tested again tomorrow. Objects vs. locations.

emotion.label: Imagery & feeling
emotion.desc: Read four short scenes, imagine each, rate how it moves you. Surprise memory test.

decay.label: Holding an image
decay.desc: How long can you keep a picture steady? 90 seconds.

draw.label: Draw it from memory
draw.desc: Study a scene, then draw it. Objects vs. layout, as in the drawing studies.

rivalry.label: Binocular rivalry (needs red/cyan glasses)
rivalry.desc: The lab-standard objective imagery test, with cheap anaglyph glasses. 16 trials.

pupil.label: Pupil & imagery (camera, experimental)
pupil.desc: Imagine bright and dark shapes while the front camera measures your pupils.

_doc: status: required | optional | blocked (shown as unavailable) | hidden (not shown). requires: keys that must be complete first. arms: list of arms that see it (omit = all). notBefore: ISO date the item opens. Arms are assigned server-side, balanced by count.
